title: Clarify the Windows case-alias claim in the Rust fixture Cargo witness
outcome: Reword or strengthen the Windows alias assertion in the fixture Cargo construction witness so it does not claim to prove an alias-removal block that std::process::Command already makes redundant through case-insensitive environment keys. Preserve discriminating target, intermediate, cwd and descendant checks.
acceptance: The witness's stated guarantee is limited to assertions that discriminate, or a strengthened native-child raw-environment witness fails when the claimed behavior is removed.
Existing fixture-local target/intermediate/cwd, unrelated diagnostic preservation and descendant checks remain intact.
